body: Tasks 1 and 3 of the plan are implemented and their tests pass. Config reads RATE_LIMIT_MAX and RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS, validates both at startup and refuses to boot on a non-integer or a value below 1. The middleware rejects an over-budget request with 429 and a Retry-After header carrying whole seconds.U+000AU+000ATask 2, the Redis token bucket, is written but not yet correct under concurrency. The read-modify-write is three round trips, so two simultaneous requests from the same address can both observe a token and both consume it. The fix is a Lua script so the whole bucket update is one atomic call; that is the next thing to write.U+000AU+000ATask 4, restart safety, is untouched and blocked on task 2 being correct, because a restart test over a racy bucket cannot distinguish the two failures.
